cutoff_evidence.cutoff_cross_check: Every existing KB 2026090003 PRE_* artifact independently carries the identical cutoff field '2026-09-10T00:00:00+09:00': 2026090003_PRE_WIN_FORECAST.json, 2026090003_PRE_PERFORMANCE_SNAPSHOT.json, 2026090003_PRE_PERFORMANCE_CORRECTED_V2.json, 2026090003_PRE_PERFORMANCE_ROW_RETENTION_CORRECTED_V2.json, 2026090003_PRE_PUBLIC_MASTER.json, 2026090003_PRE_SG_TOTAL_RANK.json, 2026090003_PRE_SG_TOTAL_RANK_CORRECTED_V2.json -- 7 independently-generated artifacts, zero disagreement.
cutoff_evidence.interpretation: PRE cutoff = local midnight (KST, +09:00) at tournament start, i.e. the instant before Round 1 could legitimately begin. This audit treats it as the hard boundary: any source dated/retrieved strictly after this instant is FUTURE DATA for PRE and is excluded.

explicitly_excluded: KB R1 SG (strokes gained computed from R1 play)
any file generated from KB R1 information
